summary: Wide dirt verge backing onto bush beside Moggill Road; homes across the road.
reasons: Bush strip on the west side
Wide dirt verge to pull onto

best_section.where: West kerb of Market Street South, beside the bush strip below Moggill Road

drivers.seclusion: West side backs onto a treed bush strip with Moggill Road beyond. Nearest mapped dwellings are 25 m or more away across the street.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide bare dirt verge beside the lane gives room to pull fully off. A car is parked on the opposite kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street; Moggill Road noise carries from the bush strip.
drivers.convention: No signs. Cars park on this street.

flags: Steep: about 4.6% grade over the section, 5.9% mean over the stretch
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the west side shades the section in the afternoon; open to morning sun over the road.
